segments.text:
V. 38.
It was a cave—So Abraham, Iſaac, and Jacob, and their Wives, except Rachel, were buried in the Cave of Machpelab (Gen. xlix. 29, 30, 31.) Theſe Caves were commonly in Rocks, which abounded in that Country, either hollowed by Nature or hewn by Art. And the Entrance was ſhut up with a great Stone, which ſometimes had a monumental Inſcription.
